responsibility: This file is a thin adapter from GNU Modula-2 code to GCC’s diagnostic colorization support. It forwards requests for color start/stop escape sequences and locale-aware open/close quote strings from diagnostic-color.h, providing the frontend and Modula-2 runtime-facing code with access to GCC’s standardized diagnostic styling without owning any color policy itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the concrete wrapper implementation around GCC diagnostic-color objects: it forwards to colorize_start/colorize_stop and returns open_quote/close_quote strings, with trivial init/finish hooks. The matching .def and .h files only publish this tiny adapter API.
